description_en: Remove an edge application from an edge instance
description_zh: 从边缘实例中移除边缘应用
kebab_example: aliyun iot unbind-application-from-edge-instance --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --instance-id Tb4r9k3GWHJFWv000000 --application-id 361368ba5a094da9bf5625d092000000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UnbindApplicationFromEdgeInstance

parameters.description_en: The instance ID. Do not pass this parameter for public instances; pass it for Enterprise instances.
parameters.description_zh: 实例ID。公共实例不传此参数，企业版实例需传入。
parameters.help_en: The instance ID. Do not pass this parameter for public instances; pass it for Enterprise instances
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID。公共实例不传此参数，企业版实例需传入
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.description_en:
The ID of the edge instance. You can obtain the ID by hovering your mouse over the name of the target edge instance on the **Edge Instances** page in the [Edge Computing console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list).

You can also call the [QueryEdgeInstance](~~135214~~) API to obtain the ID.
parameters.description_zh:
边缘实例的ID。在[边缘计算控制台](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的**边缘实例**页面中，鼠标悬浮在目标边缘实例名称上获取ID。

您也可以调用[QueryEdgeInstance](~~135214~~)接口获取。
